## Answer

**Opened in:** `frontend\src\app\components\game-console\game-console.component.ts`, method `openInventory()` (line 237), triggered from the game console UI (`game-console.component.html`). It calls `this.dialog.open(InventoryComponent, { data: dialogData, panelClass: 'inv-dialog-panel', maxHeight: '90vh' })` using Angular Material's `MatDialog`.

**Data passed:** An `InventoryDialogData` object (defined in `frontend\src\app\components\inventory\inventory.component.ts`):
```ts
{ characterId: this.characterId, sessionId: this.sessionId }
```
Inside `InventoryComponent`, this is injected via `MAT_DIALOG_DATA` as `this.data`.

**API calls it can make** (all via `GameApiService`, `frontend\src\app\services\game-api.service.ts`, hitting `${API_BASE}` Worker endpoints):
- `getInventory(characterId)` → `GET /api/character/:id` (used on `ngOnInit`/`loadInventory()`)
- `equipItem(characterId, itemId, equipped)` → `PATCH /api/character/:id/equip` (in `toggleEquip()`)
- `dropItem(characterId, itemId)` → `DELETE /api/character/:id/inventory/:itemId` (used in both `usePotion()` and `dropItem()`)

Results of these calls update local state via `CharacterStateService.setInventory()`/`setCharacter()`. Note `sessionId` is passed in dialog data but not currently used by any API call inside the component.
